name: Jund
description: A shard of the plane of Alara ruled by tyrannical hellkites and other dragons.

timeline.summary: Flashback: on Jund Sarkhan finds the dragons magnificent but unworthy and fights alongside tribes hunting Malactoth.
timeline.quote: Old Malactoth— he had been a true challenge.

timeline.summary: Alara's five shards converge into one plane flowing with all five colors of mana.
timeline.quote: But now they have converged into one, and the rejoined plane flows with all five colors of mana once more.

timeline.summary: As the boundaries dissolve, cultures clash and wars break out between the shards.
timeline.quote: As the boundaries between the shards dissolve, cultures clash and wars ensue.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan travels from plane to plane seeking a dragon to dedicate his life to, and on Jund declares fealty to Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: There, he declared his fealty to the dragon Planeswalker Nicol Bolas.

relations.note: Jund is one of the five shards of Alara.
relations.quote: Far from Zendikar lies the fivefold world of Alara .
On Jund, a shard of the plane of Alara

pages_say.description: A fierce plane of sky tyrants and dragon-hunting tribes where Sarkhan hunted dragons.
The dragon-worshiping shard of Alara with tar pits, jungles and volcanic peaks, ruled by predation.
A shard of Alara: a primordial hunting-ground ruled by dragons.
A shard of the plane of Alara ruled by tyrannical hellkites and other dragons.
